findings.description: After adding, editing or deleting an expense the list and Total are stale: the page shows 'Expense saved' but the new/edited row is missing and the total is unchanged for roughly 30 seconds (other sessions/viewers too). The edit page and /expenses/N/edit already show the new data, so the list appears served from a stale cache. A deleted row also keeps showing.
repro: After redirect to /expenses?flash=saved, observe the row is absent and Total still $399.99
Open /expenses/9/edit - the record exists; reload /expenses after ~30 s and the row and Total $409.99+ appear

findings.description: Total does not respect the category filter: filtering by travel, meals or office (or an unknown category that yields an empty table) still shows the grand total $399.99, which does not match the rows displayed.
repro: Also /expenses?category=bogus shows no rows but Total $399.99

findings.description: Server-side validation failures (empty/blank title, negative or non-numeric amount, amount with more than 2 decimals, bad category) return 400 and re-render a blank form with no error message and the user's input discarded, so the user does not know why the save failed.
repro: POST /expenses with title empty or amount=-5 (e.g. bypass HTML min via devtools)
Response is 400 with an empty 'Add expense' form and no error text

findings.description: Unreasonable input is accepted: amount 0, amount 99999999999 and a 5000-character title are saved without limits or error.
repro: POST /expenses with amount=99999999999 or a 5000 char title

findings.description: Deleting a non-existent expense id (POST /expenses/999/delete) redirects to /expenses as if successful instead of returning 404 (edit of a missing id returns 404).

notes: Delete has no confirmation (not reported). Permissions for viewer (403 on new/edit/create/delete) and unauthenticated redirect behave correctly. Total arithmetic of seed data is correct.

cost.notes: estimate from 34046 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0068-$0.0817
